details:
"IMPOSSIBLE TO POSSIBLE" is a digital comic story that tells the contribution of the spacecrafts Apollo 11's Eagle, Pathfinder's rover Sojourner and the twin robotic geologists Spirit and Opportunity in succeeding NASA'S space exploration missions.

It's focused on making the school age space enthusiasts aware of the untold story of NASA'S space equipment through a creative approach.

Tools used:

  • Ibis Paint X
  • Google Gemini
